name: session-board
description: /sessions opens a board of every Claude Code session on this machine from the last day: folder, running or not, context size with a handoff mark, usage today, idle time, subagents and its last line. Costliest first, with a resume command to copy and a button to ask a running session to hand off.

hours.title: Look-back (hours)
hours.description: List sessions active within this many hours.

handoffAt.title: Handoff mark (tokens)
handoffAt.description: A session whose context is at or above this size is marked "handoff due".
